caption: The drawing depicts a formal garden and orchard layout, viewed from above. At the top of the image, there are two rectangular plots bordered by red lines, each filled with evenly spaced green trees on a light green ground. Below these, a wide pathway runs horizontally across the image. Continuing down, there are three distinct sections separated by green borders. The central section contains a pair of gray rectangular buildings with red dots at the corners, surrounded by several evenly spaced green trees on a light green background. The left and right sections each feature more scattered trees within bordered grassy areas. Below this, the lower half of the image is dominated by a large, geometrically divided garden composed of multiple rectangular and irregularly shaped beds, each filled with symmetrical rows of green, red, yellow, and white plants, trees, or flowers. The beds are separated by straight pathways meeting at a circular plaza in the center, which contains a round fountain or structure at its core. In the bottom left corner, there is a decorative blue and gray shield-like crest with a green tree and the name "Watts" written below it. The background of the entire image is shaded in various tones of green and blue, suggesting a wooded or natural setting with indistinct trees and foliage around the bordered plots.
title: Watts Estate and Garden
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
